records.text: An anonymous source told Owens that Michael McCoy was the most emotionally affected and upset person at the hospital after Charlie Kirk's shooting.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep a2bZf4fic10)

appearances.snippet: one of the things I was told about Mikey (Michael McCoy) in the hospital was that they were lying. ... That was patently untrue. Mikey (Michael McCoy) was the most emotionally impacted. ... Mikey (Michael McCoy), who was in the background, who was physically sick, is what I was told from the very beginning. ... Mikey (Michael McCoy) had raw emotion at the hospital. Of all of them, Mikey (Michael McCoy) was the most upset

verification.notes: The transcript shows Owens relaying information she said she had received about Michael McCoy at the hospital and describing a public clip as consistent with it. The purported source is anonymous, and no independent hospital witness, contemporaneous record, or attributable account was found that establishes McCoy was the most emotionally affected person present. The private-source claim remains unverifiable.
